# MoCHII He I 2^3S metastable (triplet) coefficients.
# generated by tools/fitting/make_hei_metastable.py (the auditable
# source; see its docstring for every choice made here)
#
# Balance, linear in n_3 (hei_metastable_mod::hei_triplet_population):
#   n_3 = n_e [alpha_3 n_HeII + (q_13 + q_feed) n_HeI]
#       / [A_31 + Phi_3 + n_e (q_31g + q_31a + q_31b + q_31s + C_3)
#          + n_HI Q_31]
# alpha_3 is NOT in this file: alpha_3 = f_3S(T) alpha_B(He II), the
#   triplet share of the case-B cascade (hei_cascade_mod) times the
#   balance's own case-B coefficient (recomb_mod).  The earlier
#   ALPHA3/ALPHA1 rows (Oklopcic & Hirata 2018) are gone, and a file
#   carrying them is refused.
#
# Provenance:
#  UPSILON rows: effective collision strengths of Bray, Burgess, Fursa
#     & Tully (2000, A&AS 146, 481), Tables 2 (1^1S -> n^3L) and 3
#     (2^3S -> n^(2S+1)L), n <= 5, at log T = 3.75 ... 5.75 as
#     printed; at log T = 3.00, 3.25, 3.50 the temperature dependence
#     of the CHIANTI v11.0.2 he_1 strength of the same term (J levels
#     summed; Burgess & Tully descaled) anchored to the Bray value at
#     10^3.75 K, or the 10^3.75 K value held where CHIANTI carries no
#     level of the term.  Rate q = BETA Upsilon exp(-dE/kT)/(g_l sqrt T),
#     BETA = h^2/[(2 pi m_e)^1.5 k^0.5] (CODATA 2018); dE from the
#     g-weighted observed term energies of CHIANTI he_1.elvlc.
#     Upsilon: log-log linear between nodes, end values held outside.
#     q_31g (2^3S -> 1^1S) = q_13 (g_1/g_3) exp(E_13/kT) from the Q13 row.
#  C_3 : e-impact ionization of 2^3S, Black (1981, MNRAS 197, 553) eq. 12,
#     8.38e-10 T^0.5 exp(-55338/T), Taylor, Kingston & Bell (1979) cross
#     sections, 1e3-1e5 K.
#  A_31 = 1.272e-4 s^-1 (2^3S->1^1S, lifetime ~7870 s).  PITFALL: the
#     CHIANTI he_1.wgfa A(1-2)=1.73e-4 is ~36% high; do NOT use it.
#  Q_31 : Penning + associative ionization He(2^3S)+H0, Garcia Munoz
#     (2025, A&A 698 A199) Fig. 5: Maxwellian average of the Movre &
#     Meyer (1997) cross sections, k = 1e-9 exp(c/T + d1 lnT + d2 lnT^2
#     + d3 lnT^3), <2% over 200-1e4 K; reproduces the paper's Table A.5.
#     c is DIVIDED BY T (the paper's network file prints exp(c)).
#     Penning : associative = 0.9 : 0.1 (the paper's average); both
#     counted as H0 -> H+ in MoCHII, which carries no HeH+.
#  sigma_3(E) : He 2^3S photoionization, two VFKY96 wings + a log-linear
#     bridge; ~4% fit to Norcross (1971) + TOPbase (EXHALE sigma_HeI23S);
#     threshold 4.78 eV.  Cross-checked vs p-winds (same Norcross data).
#  LINE10833 : 2^3S->2^3P_{0,1,2} fine-structure line constants for the
#     10833 A line-center absorption opacity (Stage 2).  Vacuum
#     wavelength [A], oscillator strength f, Einstein A [s^-1].  NIST
#     ASD (Drake 2007) values, via p-winds (p_winds/lines.py).  A-value
#     RESOLUTION: NIST/p-winds give A=1.0216e7 s^-1 for each component; the
#     CHIANTI he_1.wgfa ~1.15e7 (~13% high) is NOT used.  All three
#     components share A (f split 1:3:5 by g_u cancels g_l/g_u in A_ul).
#     J'=1,2 (10833.217, 10833.306) blend (0.089 A << Doppler ~0.4 A at
#     1e4 K) = the observed 'doublet'; J'=0 (10832.057) is resolved.
#
# Keyword formats (T in K, kT = KB_EV*T in eV, rates cm^3 s^-1):
#  C3TRANGE  Tmin Tmax      - C_3 is evaluated at T clamped to this range
#  Q31TRANGE Tmin Tmax      - Q_31 is evaluated at T clamped to this range
#  A31     value            - s^-1
#  BETA    value            - Maxwellian constant [cm^3 s^-1 K^0.5]
#  E23S    value            - E(2^3S) above 1^1S [eV] (observed)
#  UPSGRID n log10T(1..n)   - node temperatures of the UPSILON rows
#  UPSILON role lower n 2S+1 l g_lower dE_eV Upsilon(1..n)
#     role Q13 | FEED (lower 1 = 1^1S) or Q31A | Q31B | SINGLET |
#     TRIPLET (lower 2 = 2^3S); upper term n^(2S+1)L with l = L;
#     dE = E(upper) - E(lower) [eV]
#  CION3   A p T0           - C_3 = A T^p exp(-T0/T)
#  PENNING A c d1 d2 d3
#     Q = A exp(c/T + d1 lnT + d2 (lnT)^2 + d3 (lnT)^3)
#  SIGMA3A/SIGMA3B  E_th E_0 s_0 y_a P y_w y_0 y_1   (VFKY96; s_0 in Mb)
#  SIGBRIDGE  E3 E4          - bridge boundaries [eV] (log-linear join)
#  LINE10833  lambda_vac_A f A   - 10833 fine-structure component
#     (one line for each 2^3P_J component; kappa_0 = sqrt(pi) e^2/(m_e c)
#      f (lambda/b) n_3, b = sqrt(2 k T_e/m_He + v_turb^2))
#
